# Stick It Up (stickitupx.com)

> Free, open-source UI sticker component library for React and Next.js featuring 65+ interactive vector, metallic chrome, and retro pixel art stickers with realistic 3D vinyl hover peel physics.

- Website: https://stickitupx.com
- Stickers Catalog: https://stickitupx.com/stickers
- GitHub: https://github.com/Sam721166/stick-it-up
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/stick-it-up
- License: MIT (100% free for personal and commercial use)

---

## Installation

Install via npm, pnpm, or bun:

```bash
npm install stick-it-up@latest
# or
pnpm add stick-it-up@latest
# or
bun add stick-it-up@latest
```

Requirements: React 18 or React 19. Fully compatible with Next.js App Router and Pages Router.

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Dynamic `<Sticker />` Component

Import the universal `Sticker` component and specify the sticker by name:

```tsx
import { Sticker } from "stick-it-up";

export default function Hero() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      {/* Vinyl hover peel physics enabled */}
      <Sticker name="star" size={80} peel />

      {/* Static vector emblem */}
      <Sticker name="flame" size={64} />

      {/* Pixel art mascot */}
      <Sticker name="nori-coffee" size={96} peel />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### 2. Direct Named Component Imports (Tree-shakeable)

Each sticker is also available as an individually exported, tree-shakeable component:

```tsx
import { 
  FlameSticker, 
  MetalSticker, 
  NoriCoffeeSticker, 
  StarBurstSticker 
} from "stick-it-up";

export default function Badge() {
  return (
    <FlameSticker size={72} peel className="hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
  );
}
```

---

## Component API & Props

The `<Sticker />` component accepts all standard SVG HTML attributes (`SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>`) plus:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `name` | `StickerName` | *(required)* | Unique name of the sticker (e.g. `"flame"`, `"nori-coffee"`). |
| `size` | `number \| string` | `100` | Width and height shortcut in pixels (`80`) or CSS units (`"5rem"`, `"100%"`). |
| `peel` | `boolean` | `false` | Enables physical 3D vinyl hover peel tilt with depth lighting. |
| `className` | `string` | `undefined` | Additional Tailwind or CSS classes applied to the sticker. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | `undefined` | Custom inline CSS styles. |

---

## Available Stickers (65+)

### Aesthetic Shapes & Chrome Emblems
- `flame` — Metallic chrome flame emblem
- `metal` — Y2K metallic liquid chrome badge
- `star-burst` — 8-point silver holographic star
- `blob-burst` — Iridescent liquid chrome splash
- `devil-cone` — Spiked chrome emblem
- `flame-star` — Chrome star wrapped in fire
- `folded-paper` — Paper decal with folded corner
- `cosmic-pill` — Chrome capsule with holographic gradient
- `badge-smiley` — Acid smiley badge
- `icy-fleur` — Liquid chrome fleur-de-lis
- `spiral` — Hypnotic chrome vortex

### Pixel Art & Mascots
- `nori-coffee` — Nori the mascot sipping coffee
- `nori-cool` — Nori wearing sunglasses
- `nori-headphones` — Nori listening to beats
- `nori-heart` — Nori holding a pixel heart
- `nori-laptop` — Nori hacking on a laptop
- `nori-rocket` — Nori flying a retro spaceship
- `cat` / `black-cat` / `pink-cat` / `yellow-cat` / `red-cat` — Retro pixel cat variants
- `cat-serious` — Serious pixel kitty
- `dog` — Retro pixel puppy
- `bunny` — Floating pixel bunny

### Nature & Fruit
- `red-berry` / `blueberry` / `berries` — Glossy fruit stickers
- `cherry` — Double glossy cherries
- `flower` — Retro graphic flower decal

### Badges, Gestures & Emblems
- `peace-hand` — Retro graphic peace sign
- `cosmic-eye` — Third eye mystic badge
- `curious-globe` — Friendly illustrated planet
- `japan-badge` / `japan-flag` — Tokyo graphic emblems
- `luffy-hat` — Straw hat emblem
- `sparkles` / `sparkle-trio` — Holographic sparkle stars
- `nazar` — Evil eye talisman badge
- `app-badge` — Modern rounded squircle app tile

---

## Next.js App Router Integration

Stick It Up components run client-side interactivity (`"use client"`). In Next.js Server Components, render them directly inside your pages:

```tsx
// app/page.tsx
import { Sticker } from "stick-it-up";

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <main className="p-8">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
        Welcome to my site
        <Sticker name="sparkles" size={32} peel />
      </h1>
    </main>
  );
}
```
